Chapter 1114 – Zhao Feng’s God Eye

True God Tian Fan had a very ugly expression. He was a prodigy both in his family and the Ancient Soul Palace. He had never been so heavily injured in his entire life. He was a Third Rank True God, and even though he was suppressing his cultivation, his Divine Body and powerful bloodline should make his defense flawless.

Now, not only were his Divine Body and bloodline injured, even the Seven Ocean Demonic Dragon Armor was heavily damaged. What made him even more surprised though was that his Divine Body was recovering very slowly after being damaged by that mysterious power.

He didn’t think that the combined forces of a few normal God Eye descendants would be able to unleash such terrifying force.

“He’s still not dead?” The Black Destruction Serpent Dragon was in utter shock. Even it couldn’t understand the mystic power a moment ago.

“What strength!” Demigod Dark Dragon was very surprised.

The combined forces of five God Eye descendants was indeed very strong, but even this wasn’t enough to kill the True God. From this, one could see that the strength of this True God was not simple. The quality of his divine items was also probably extremely high.

“But with this True God’s current injuries, he shouldn’t be our match now!” Demigod Dragon Emperor said.

“Is this the power of a True God?” Zhao Feng was in complete shock as he looked at True God Tian Fa.

The difference between even a regular True God and a Demigod was far too big. The result of their attack meant that this True God was a powerful existence even in the Ancient Desolate Realm of Gods, and he had many techniques and skills.

“It’s too early for you to be happy!!” The purple lines on True God Tian Fa’s dark skin started to rise up and down as a terrifying bloodline Divine Power started to spread.

“Not good!” Demigod Dragon Emperor exclaimed. All the Demigods instantly went on guard, and the Sacred Lords and Sacred Kings behind the Demigods instantly retreated.

Bai Lin seemed to sense something and entered the Origin Dimension of the Black Destruction Serpent Dragon.

“Divine technique – Dark Soul Shockwave!” True God Tian Fa circulated his Soul Intent and released a chaotic wave of soul power.

Weng~~

The Darkness-elemental soul attack swept across every direction with extremely quick speed and travelled several thousand miles. All of Heaven and Earth became dark as the experts within the God corpse had to face a terrifying soul attack. Even the Demigods felt as if their souls had entered hell itself and were being continuously attacked.

Although the Sacred Lords and Sacred Kings were far away from True God Tian Fa, they were still unable to block the terrifying blast of soul power. In just an instant, several dozen Sacred Lords and five Sacred Kings were killed by True God Tian Fa’s soul attack. The injuries to the Demigods became worse, and a small number of them couldn’t fight anymore.

However, the five God Eye descendants had a bloodline of one of the Eight Great God Eyes, so their natural resistance to soul attacks was far stronger. Demigod Destruction received light injuries, Bai Lin escaped into the Black Destruction Serpent Dragon’s body, and Sacred Lord Myriad Forms was put away by Zhao Feng.

“What terrifying battle-power!” A Demigod howled as pain surged through his head.

True God Tian Fa managed to unleash a soul attack on the entire battlefield by himself. If this True God had started off with all his power and used this killing move right away, no one would have been able to survive.

Hu~~

True God Tian Fa’s eyes locked onto the area near the Sacred Kings and found that the five God Eye descendants were still alive. It was obvious that True God Tian Fa’s divine technique just now was focused on the God Eye descendants, but the result didn’t go as planned.

Shua!

True God Tian Fa turned into a dark streak of light and revealed a fierce cold killing intent as he charged toward the descendants of the God Eyes.

“I will kill all of you!” True God Tian Fa revealed a gruesome expression. Right now, he needed to kill the descendants of the God Eyes before anything else.

“Stop him!” Demigod Dragon Emperor roared. The biggest card for both lord dynasties right now was the combined power of the five God Eye descendants. They couldn’t allow any accidents to happen to them or else disaster would strike the entire continent zone.

“Go!” All the Sacred Kings and Demigods knew this as well, so they teamed up and charged forward together even if they were severely injured.

“Fuck off!” True God Tian Fa had a cold expression. His gaze was still trained on the five God Eye descendants.

Hua~~~

True God Tian Fa waved his long black spear around, and a terrifying power ripped through the air.

Boom! Peng~

Several Demigods and Sacred Kings were still unable to block this power even when working together.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The God corpse shattered, and Heaven and Earth fell apart. Although True God Tian Fa was heavily injured right now, he still attacked at full power, which was enough to destroy the world!

“Everyone, please use the secret technique that you used a moment ago!” Demigod Dragon Emperor messaged the five God Eye descendants.

They were everyone’s last hope. They had already heavily injured True God Tian Fa, so he would definitely be unable to withstand a second attack from the five God Eyes. This was the whole reason True God Tian Fa was attacking at full power.

“There should be no problem, right?” Sacred King Samsara communicated with the others.

“We can do it!” The other God Eye descendants didn’t reject it. After all, this regarded their life and death too. They had to use their full strength.

“Zhao Feng, you can participate this time as well!” Sacred King Samsara thought for a while before saying.

“Why?” Demigod Destruction was shocked, but Bai Lin and the Emperor of Death remained silent.

“His eye contained a wisp of a God Eye aura… and it has the potential to become the Ninth God’s Eye…!” Sacred King Samsara said.

“What!?” Demigod Destruction was shocked. At this moment, he suddenly remembered the wisp of God Eye aura that his Eyes of Destruction felt when they performed the attack. He thought that it was just an accident, but could it be… the aura came from Zhao Feng’s eye?

“Let’s start. If possible, I will participate!” Zhao Feng’s expression became grim. Although the non-humans didn’t really like Zhao Feng already, he was still troubled by the fact that Sacred King Samsara had revealed his secret to a non-human.

Whoosh! Whoosh!

The five God Eye descendants and Zhao Feng all started to use the technique.

“Power of Origin!”

Boom! Boom! Boom…!

The five God Eye descendants all directed their Power of Origin out again.

Hmm…. How should I direct the Power of Origin out from my God’s Spiritual Eye?

Zhao Feng paused for a moment. Ever since he started cultivating, the God’s Spiritual Eye only released some of its hidden power on its own, but that power didn’t seem to be the true Power of Origin of the God’s Spiritual Eye. Zhao Feng also didn’t know what the Power of Origin the God’s Spiritual Eye even had or where it was.

“Hmph! The Ninth God’s Eye is just a legend!” Demigod Destruction couldn’t help but smile after seeing no reaction from Zhao Feng after such a long time.

The Power of Origin that God Eyes and their descendants possessed came naturally. It was impossible for other bloodlines to have them.

On the other side, True God Tian Fa’s eyes became sharp.

“How could the same move work on me twice!?” True God Tian Fa had a fierce gaze. He had only been severely injured the first time because he underestimated his opponents. This time, True God Tian Fa wouldn’t give the God Eye descendants a chance to use their move again.

“Die!” True God Tian Fa unleashed his bloodline Divine Power.

Boom!

A terrifying beam of light suddenly shot out from the black spear like a cannon. It shot through several thousand miles and destroyed everything in its path.

Boom! Peng! Bam!

Five Demigods were instantly blasted aside by this terrifying power, and one of them, who was already heavily injured, was killed.

Whoosh!

After blasting away the Demigods, True God Tian Fa used a profound movement skill and charged toward the God Eye descendants.

“Not good! True God Tian Fa has broken through the defenses!” Demigod Withered Breath cried out.

“Freeze!” Sacred King Samsara felt a critical danger and immediately started to use the technique.

Weng~~

The five Powers of Origin were led by his power of Samsara and started to twist together.

“It’s too late. Die!” True God Tian Fa laughed gruesomely and waved the black spear.

However, right at this instant, the mysterious golden ball within Zhao Feng’s God Eye dimension started to tremble. It was as if the merging of the God Eye powers could direct out the Power of Origin from Zhao Feng’s God’s Spiritual Eye.

Zhao Feng went with the flow of the mysterious golden ball and started to help direct out the power.

Weng~~~

Zhao Feng’s eyes suddenly opened and radiated a dreamy light. The instant this power appeared, the five Powers of Origin twisting in the air instantly stopped moving and started to tremble.

“An ancient Power of Origin!” True God Tian Fa couldn’t distinguish what kind of power this was, but he could feel a very thick source of ancient Power of Origin from it.

“This power…?” True God Tian Fa’s heart shook. In an instant, his Divine Body, soul, and Divine Power were suppressed and unable to move. When he faced this mysterious dreamy power, he felt as if he was a mortal – infinitesimal, as if he had to bow to this power.

“What’s going on?”

“This is completely different from before!”

The hearts of the Sacred Kings and Demigods shook as they fell to the ground with blank minds.

“The aura of Ancient Origin!” Demigod Dragon Emperor croaked out.

Hu!

This dreamy mysterious power charged toward the Powers of Origin from the descendants of the God Eyes.

Weng~~

The Powers of Origin from the five God Eye descendants were engulfed by this dreamy mysterious power. The sky started to twist as lights shone in the sky. The laws and Intents of Heaven and Earth turned chaotic and became one!

“This is…!?” Zhao Feng opened his eyes. At this instant, he seemed to become Heaven and Earth, and he was able to control everything in them. His every thought could control the world. It was as if, as long as Zhao Feng had the thought, the earth would disappear.

“Divine Technique – Dark Soul Escape!” True God Tian Fa’s heart shook, and his soul trembled as he burned all his Divine Power and Soul Intent to turn into a black mist.

“Go!”

This time, Zhao Feng was the director of the mysterious power, and he directed this forbidden power toward True God Tian Fa.

Weng~~ Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!

At this instant, everything within several thousand miles started to shake, and all the beings bowed in front of this devastating power.

“What kind of power is this!?” The Demigods and Sacred Kings in the God corpse felt their hearts turn cold, and they rushed away.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

Wherever this forbidden power passed, Heaven and Earth turned into nothingness. The ground shattered. It was as if a part of Heaven and Earth had been lost, and the lower half of the God corpse was completely destroyed! Countless cracks rippled across the sky. The power of each crack was enough to kill normal Demigods!
